title: RDX Judgment Finding v1
description: Shape of a single finding emitted by the rdx-judgment skill (Cat-3 evaluator). One finding per rule per location. Verdict semantics per RDX_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_TESTED.md §7.2.

rule_id.description: Canonical rule ID — must match an entry in rule-check-map.json.

category.description: Rule category. If set, MUST match rule-check-map.json. Used by the Cat-1 immutability guard.

contract_ref.description: Reference to the rule contract (e.g. 'RDX KB section-6.2', 'GOV-003 governance doc').

reasoning.description: Why this finding applies — must cite evidence from the diff/code/story, not personal preference.

verdict.description: Evaluator verdict. PASS/FAIL set by evaluator for Cat-3 only. Cat-1/2 verdicts are set by the validator; rdx-judgment must NOT emit a finding whose category=1 and verdict in {PASS,FAIL} (see allOf below).

confidence.description: Evaluator confidence in [0,1]. Low confidence + verdict=PASS → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

suggested_routing.description: Where to route the finding next. DEFER_TO_VALIDATOR is the canonical answer when category=1 — the evaluator cannot decide.

set_by.description: Origin of the finding — used by the schema-level Cat-1 immutability guard.

allOf.description: Cat-1 immutability: if category=1, the evaluator MUST NOT set verdict to PASS or FAIL. Either omit set_by (validator-origin) or route to DEFER_TO_VALIDATOR / SPECIALIST_REQUIRED.
